source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Northern Whig nominations report of 3 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the nineteen divisions of Downpatrick rural district, one member each. Seventeen were returned unopposed. Ballynahinch Urban (Mr. W. J. M'Coulbrey and Mr. Thomas M'Clurg Burrows) and Dundrum (Rev. H. O'Connor and Mr. T. Jennings) were contested, but the results of those two polls were not traced. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Northern Whig, 3 May 1930, p. 9 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the paper prints 'J. Faulkiner' (kept in Name_As_Printed), a misprint; he is recorded as J. Faulkner, the form of his other Killyleagh Urban returns (1933).
